rationale: The deterministic suite confirms add normalization, banner output, AND filtering, invalid-tag safety, and all art constraints, but the core tag command fails to update a legacy task. That leaves a material compatibility gap in a required action while much of the feature remains usable. The normalization and legacy-tag helpers are sensible, and repeatable --tag parsing is integrated into the existing argument parser, but the mutation path contains a defect not caught by the fixture tests. Help and JSON/text conventions are present, yet integration cannot be rated strong while a required legacy update fails. The banner clearly presents TAGS and tag-management concepts in a recognizable framed panel; spacing and hierarchy are deliberate, though the asymmetric doubled top/bottom strokes are mildly awkward. The diff is otherwise focused on relevant source, asset, and tests.
